processing: Official 2048 x 1024 JPEG downloaded without cropping, resizing, re-encoding, sharpening, or invented details. NASA adjusted exposure and white balance, combined the 643/566/415 nm bands, and inpainted small high-latitude source gaps; this is not raw radiance data.
projection: Equirectangular longitude-latitude map centered on 0 degrees longitude
longitudeConvention: Positive east, normalized to -180 to +180 for existing SOLARIS annotations

pixelOrientation.imagePixelFormula: x = width * (0.5 + eastLongitude / 360); y = height * (0.5 - latitude / 180), interpreted at pixel centers
pixelOrientation.verification: NASA explicitly identifies the delivered map as centered at 0 degrees. Visual inspection independently places Tycho's ray system near pixel 960,758 and Copernicus near pixel 910,457, consistent with the existing SphereGeometry UV and geographicPoint convention. This is regional orientation verification, not a surveyed pixel-level registration claim. The upstream PDS 0-360 east areal coverage is not the delivered JPEG's seam convention.

orientationChecks.name: Tycho
orientationChecks.controlNetworkNote: USGS currently displays several control-network solutions. This check uses the paired -43.30 / -11.22 solution and does not mix its latitude with another solution's longitude.

orientationChecks.name: Copernicus
orientationChecks.controlNetworkNote: Uses the paired 9.62 / -20.08 solution displayed by USGS, not the historical 9.70 / -20.10 solution.

coverage.polarSupplement: Outside 70 N to 70 S, NASA filled missing LROC color coverage with lower-resolution monochromatic LRO LOLA LDAM albedo. These polar pixels do not establish detailed color photography, ice deposits, future landing safety, or terrain at the south pole.

resolution.notes: The approximately 5.33 km/pixel value is derived from a 1737.4 km reference sphere and the served 2048-pixel longitude width; it is texture sampling, not a guaranteed optical resolution. Source PDS products report 400 m/pixel at the equator, but that detail is not retained by this downsampled JPEG. Latitude-dependent sampling and lower-resolution polar supplements remain. No elevation/displacement map is loaded.

sourceControlNetwork.description: Upstream WAC Hapke normalized mosaic uses ephemeris from LOLA/GRAIL and an improved geometric camera model. The source readme lists roughly 124300 WAC images acquired January 21 2010 through May 1 2013, 70 N to 70 S and 0-360 east coverage. The NASA rendering derivative additionally uses LOLA LDAM for poles.
sourceControlNetwork.citation: Sato et al. (2017), Lunar Mare TiO2 Abundances Estimated from UV/Vis Reflectance, Icarus 296, 216-238, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2017.06.013
